mentions.name: Intrasti
mentions.description: A passion-project website directory that indexes websites organized by topics. A redesign is underway to rebalance the focus between websites and topics — currently topics dominate — replacing the live 'shelves' approach with a new 'topic card' UI. The build uses only the web platform (no Tailwind or CSS frameworks), relying on child combinators for maintainable CSS, and the codebase was recently reorganized from a domain-driven structure to a flat, horizontally layered layout.
mentions.problem: The directory currently focuses heavily on topics rather than balancing focus between websites and topics.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently working on a redesign for my passion project website directory intrasti.com. There's websites and topics but there's a lot of focus on topics. I'd like to bring the focus away from topics and balance it out between them. The new design is going to introduce a new 'topic card' UI instead of a shelves approach that's currently live.

mentions.name: Intrasti
mentions.description: A website directory (intrasti.com) that celebrates the best of the internet without pay-to-win or manipulative dynamics. It supports website submissions and topic creation, where topics are collections of websites; upcoming work includes a unified submission flow and a site-wide overhaul focused on accessibility.
mentions.problem: Existing website directories can be pay-to-win and manipulative; this one aims to highlight the best of the internet in a fair, non-manipulative way.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a website directory (intrasti.com), not really sure what the direction is other than I'd like to celebrate the best of the internet in a way that isn't pay to win, manipulative, or anything like that.
